lines.x: Swiss consumer price inflation accelerated, prompting the Swiss National Bank to signal concern over broader price pressures.
Swiss industrial group ABB is preparing a potential initial public offering for its robotics unit if its planned sale to Japan’s SoftBank Group faces regulatory opposition in China.
Norway's sovereign wealth fund sold the Uetlihof office complex in Zurich for 850 million Swiss francs to real estate funds managed by UBS Asset Management.
SNB Vice Chairman Antoine Martin stated that the Swiss central bank is closely tracking potential second-round inflation pressures ahead of its upcoming monetary policy meeting.
